title: AudioMetadata
description: Metadata describes the input audio content. Set this in `Part.audio_metadata` or `FunctionResponsePart.audio_metadata` when `inline_data` or `file_data` contains audio to configure static audio preprocessing.

startOffset.description: Optional. The start offset of the audio, relative to the start of the audio stream.

endOffset.description: Optional. The end offset of the audio, relative to the start of the audio stream.
